tools.name: tokenomics_token-vesting-schedule-audit
tools.description: Audit caller-supplied token vesting allocations against a declared supply. Checks totals, cliff and vesting dates, duplicate beneficiaries, overlapping schedules, and distribution records. audit_status is valid, warnings, invalid, or incomplete. Supported models are linear and custom. A linear sched

tools.name: tokenomics_vesting-dilution
tools.description: Project a caller-supplied circulating supply and price across vesting cliffs. Each schedule unlocks one period at its cliff month, then monthly until it is fully unlocked. The FDV curve holds the price constant. The dilution score mixes the locked share with the largest single-month unlock. No price
